title: Integrating serum metabolomics analysis and network pharmacology to reveal the potential mechanism of Shengmai Jianghuang San in the treatment of nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
authors: Zeng, Siying; Zhu, Yuanchao; Su, Chao; Jiang, Ziqing; You, Yanyi; Zhu, Daoqi; Fan, Qin
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过血清代谢组学与网络药理学探讨中药复方治疗鼻咽癌的机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Shengmai Jianghuang San (SMJHS) is a traditional Chinese herbal compound reported to inhibit Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma (NPC) progression and enhance radiosensitivity. However, the specific active ingredients and regulatory mechanisms of SMJHS against NPC, particularly under hypoxic conditions, remain unclear. In this study, Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats were gavaged with Shengmai Jianghuang San (SMJHS), and their blood was collected from the abdominal aorta. UHPLC-Q-Exactive orbitrap MS/MS was used to identify the metabolite profiles of SMJHS drug-containing serum. A molecular network of the active compositions in SMJHS targeting NPC was constructed through network pharmacology and molecular docking. The HIF-1alpha/VEGF pathway was in key positions. The effects of SMJHS on the proliferation, migration, and radiosensitivity of hypoxic NPC cells were assessed by in vitro experiments. NPC cell lines stably overexpressing HIF-1alpha were established using a lentivirus to investigate the regulation of HIF-1alpha/VEGF signaling in hypoxic NPC cells by SMJHS. Through a combination of network pharmacological analysis, cellular biofunctional validation, and molecular biochemical experiments, our study found that SMJHS had an anti-proliferative effect on NPC cells cultured under hypoxic conditions, inhibiting their migration and increasing their radiosensitivity. Additionally, SMJHS suppressed the expression of HIF-1alpha and VEGFA, exhibiting potential as an effective option for improving NPC treatment.
abstract_zh: 生脉姜黄散（SMJHS）是一种传统中药复方，据报道可抑制鼻咽癌（NPC）进展并增强放射敏感性。然而，SMJHS 对抗 NPC 的具体活性成分及调控机制，尤其是在低氧条件下，仍不清楚。本研究通过给 Sprague-Dawley（SD）大鼠灌胃生脉姜黄散（SMJHS），并从腹主动脉采集血液。采用 UHPLC-Q-Exactive orbitrap MS/MS 鉴定 SMJHS 含药血清的代谢物谱。通过网络药理学和分子对接构建了 SMJHS 中靶向 NPC 的活性成分分子网络。HIF-1alpha/VEGF 通路处于关键位置。通过体外实验评估了 SMJHS 对低氧 NPC 细胞增殖、迁移和放射敏感性的影响。利用慢病毒建立了稳定过表达 HIF-1alpha 的 NPC 细胞系，以研究 SMJHS 对低氧 NPC 细胞中 HIF-1alpha/VEGF 信号通路的调控。通过网络药理学分析、细胞生物功能验证和分子生化实验的结合，本研究发现 SMJHS 对在低氧条件下培养的 NPC 细胞具有抗增殖作用，抑制其迁移并增加其放射敏感性。此外，SMJHS 抑制了 HIF-1alpha 和 VEGFA 的表达，显示出作为改善 NPC 治疗的有效选择的潜力。
